content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggereD: gpu-ecc-error-spike on cluster-gamma at 05:33 UTC. Affected nodes: gpu-12, gpu-14, gpu-15. Symptoms: ECC single-bit bursts, sporadic kernel retries, and 503s from inference frontends. paging policy: P1 - oncall.

mira: I'm on it. grabbing logs and checking which customers were on those nodes.

sam: saw a brief spike in VRAM OOMs around the same time on the node metrics — might be related to a bad quantization fallback in the runtime. checking katana logs.

alex: I can take mitigation. plan: 1) cordon+drain affected nodes, 2) move critical tenant pods to healthy nodes, 3) silence noisy ECC alert to avoid pagers while we triage. any objections?

jordan: +1 to draining. add a short mute window and change alert behavior to paged only if ECC errors persist for 5m across 2 nodes. Right now it pages on any single ECC spike which is too noisy.

lee: customer-impact? ops dashboard shows a small set of customers with elevated 5xx. looks like two jobs from customer "atlas-app" experienced retries and timeouts. their latency p95 spiked from 120ms -> 1.3s. I'll message CS.

kai: running the drain now:```
kubectl cordon gpu-12
kubectl drain gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl drain gpu-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

mira: confirmed pods evicted, autoscaler adding capacity and scheduler is placing pods on gpu-21/gpu-22. backend errors dropping.

ops-bot: autoscaler: launched 2 extra instances in pool-gpu to compensate (scale +2)

sam: while draining, I pulled the runtime logs. seeing repeated kernel recoveries + ECC count increments: snippet:
```
[00:33:45] ECC_SINGLE_BIT_ERROR: GPU 14 +1
[00:33:46] kernel: Freed 512MB VRAM from lru cache
[00:33:47] runtime: kernel-recover: attempt 2
[00:33:50] ECC_MULTI_BIT_WARNING: GPU 14 +1
```

alex: we should avoid paging on every ECC_SINGLE_BIT_ERROR. proposed immediate action: silence the ecc-single alert for 30m with a temporary annotation and create a follow-up to change alert rule to: "ECC_SINGLE_BIT errors > 5 within 10m across >1 node" -> page. Also add a non-paging grafana panel for ECC rate.

mira: agreed. silence done: `/alert mute ecc-single --duration 30m --reason "post-incident triage"` :white_check_mark:

jordan: opened a quick dashboard PR for node health: includes GPU ECC rate (1m,5m), VRAM alloc failure rate, thermal excursions, and drain events. link: https://grafana.internal/d/xyz/gpu-node-health (placeholder)

lee: notified CS and pinged Atlas-app with status and rollback suggestion. they acknowledged, no escalations so far.

kai: after moving pods, p50/p95 are back to normal for most tenants. I'll keep monitoring for 20m.

sam: proposal for permanent tuning:
- Change ECC alert to only page for multi-bit ECC or sustained single-bit bursts (threshold above).
- Add a secondary non-paging signal for single events so SRE can watch trends.
- VRAM OOM alert: switch to a percentile-based rule (p99 VRAM alloc failures > 0.5% over 10m) rather than instant alert.
- Thermal alerts: avoid immediate page unless node temp > 90C and accompanied by throttling.

alex: add runbook updates: include steps to check kernel logs, how to safely drain GPU nodes (eviction annotations), and when to escalate to hardware vendor.

mira: I'll create a postmortem stub and capture customer impact (Atlas-app retries + logs). tagging sam for logs, jordan for dashboard, alex for runbook.

jordan: creating an alerting RFC issue: GH-7842 "gpu-health: reduce ecc noise, add dashboards, runbook". I'll copy this thread into it and assign reviewers.

kai: monitoring note: also consider adding a rolling dedupe window to the pager so duplicate alerts from the same fault don't page repeatedly. reduces wakeups.

lee: customer update sent: "We detected a hardware error affecting a small number of GPU nodes; workloads were moved to healthy nodes, and requests recovered. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with mitigations." they asked for ETA, gave "investigation + 24h follow-up".

mira: quick post-incident checklist items assigned: 
- sam: collect and upload kernel logs + runtime traces to the incident folder (DONE by 2054331500)
- jordan: PR for dashboard (in review)
- alex: edit runbook and update drain commands (ETA 2054337200)
- lee: customer comms thread and incident severity classification (P2 -> P3 after mitigation)
- kai: update alert rules proposal in Prometheus (link in RFC)

sam: uploaded logs here: https://s3.internal/incident/2054329999/logs.tar.gz (redacted link)

incident-bot: Incident closed for paging: no further ECC multi-bit errors after draining and nodes are in maintenance. Closure notes: mitigations succeeded, follow-ups created.

mira: thanks all. small lessons: 1) ECC single-bit noise should not immediate-page, 2) have an automated node-drain runbook for GPUs, 3) add capacity-buffer config for noisy hardware. will summarize in postmortem. :memo:

alex: +1. also let's add a one-click dashboard link in the pager payload for next time.

lee: moving thread to postmortems queue and filing customer impact doc.

kai: leaving monitoring watch for another 40m then handoff to infra-run.

sam: marking tasks in tickets. good triage. :thumbsup:

mira: handing off to infra-run for overnight monitoring. /handoff @infra-run

ops-bot: handoff recorded: from mira to infra-run at 2054333600

mira: offcall. thanks everyone.
